controller projection excludes provenance payload while catalog retains it

rollback.route: Revert the two additive catalog commits or stop importing the catalog; no canonical state restoration is required.

falsification_route: Run the committed test file, inspect every catalog provenance statement, and compare getControllerProductions output against the repertory controller production contract.
